calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_distinct_rl
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_units,
 (SELECT SUM(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS fact_units,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS dup_ids

SELECT cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS asof_sub, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.quantity) units, MAX(f.quantity) maxq, MIN(f.quantity) minq, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND cp.subcategory IN ('Fixings & Fasteners','Indoor Lighting','Storage Boxes','Plants & Flowers','Cleaning Products')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) returned_units

JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
